clips.title: The story
paras: A bounty posted by the Stromgarde Militia marks Lord Falconcrest, leader of the local Syndicate forces, and his deadly bodyguard Otto for death. Eliminating them strikes a crucial blow against the criminal organization's foothold in the Arathi Highlands. Proof of their demise must be delivered to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

The Stromgarde Militia has issued an official bounty targeting two key figures in the Arathi Highlands: Lord Falconcrest and his ferocious bodyguard, Otto. Stationed out of Refuge Pointe, the beleaguered defenders of Stromgarde seek to break the Syndicate's hold over their ancestral lands. Hunters must bring the heads of both targets to Captain Nials to claim the reward.

Lord Falconcrest serves as the mastermind behind the Syndicate's coordinated push into the Arathi Highlands. His death represents a vital strategic victory for the Alliance, promising to severely disrupt the criminal network's operations in the region. Beside him stands Otto, a brutally effective bodyguard whose blades have already cut down dozens of Stromgarde's remaining militia soldiers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto. Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.
His bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.
Their bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
